edit.description: read git status NUL-separated instead of slicing quoted porcelain lines

summary: Read the clean-tree gate's status output NUL-separated so a quoted path is not a silent pass
acceptance: An untracked file inside the fence is refused whatever characters its name carries, and a refusal names the path as git spells it.
tests: the clean-tree gate refuses an untracked file inside the fence whose name git quotes
the clean-tree gate names a quoted tracked path without its quotes
notes: gates.ts:341-351 slices line.slice(3) off porcelain v1, which quotes any path needing it. Measured: `?? "sub/a b.md"` — matchesAny fails on the leading quote, the line is filtered out, and the leftover is discarded at teardown while the verdict reads merged. core.quotePath=false does not help (spaces still quote); -z is unquoted.
